# build_vector: hub step, runs AFTER the parallel band barrier (reads cl_markets
      #   latest.json outputs for commodity/forex/bonds + BTC).  Verbatim from daily.yml.
      # build_feeds: assembles site/feeds/ from all available latest.json sources.
      #   Run AFTER build_vector so the hub's outputs are included.  Non-fatal.
      - name: build bitcoin vector + landing hub (build_vector)
        if: steps.mutex.outputs.skip != 'true' && steps.guard.outputs.skip != 'true'
        run: python -m scripts.build_vector

      - name: assemble machine-consumable feeds (site/feeds -> R2)
        if: steps.mutex.outputs.skip != 'true' && steps.guard.outputs.skip != 'true'
        run: python -m scripts.build_feeds || echo "::warning::build_feeds failed (non-fatal)"

# Only dirs whose FULL content is regenerated by the steps above are included:
      #
      #   stockdata — regenerated by build_baskets (spine baskets cluster above).
      #               earlyclose already publishes this dir; same justification here.
      #               --no-manifest is MANDATORY: this lane holds a partial stockdata
      #               tree; rebuilding the manifest would shrink the ~5000-name R2 list.
      #
      #   feeds     — assembled by build_feeds (step above) from whatever latest.json
      #               sources are available. NOTE: build_feeds does NOT clear the dir —
      #               it overwrites the feeds it can rebuild and leaves the rest. On this
      #               self-hosted runner the leftovers are the PRIOR nightly's files,
      #               which are byte-identical to their R2 copies (nightly is the only
      #               other feeds publisher), so the content-hash skip makes re-uploading
      #               them a no-op — no stale-clobber path. --no-manifest keeps the R2
      #               manifest intact for files not regenerated today.
      #
      # EXCLUDED (not fully rebuilt by this lane):
      #   ohlc, intlohlc, canadaohlc, subsectorohlc* — per-name OHLC; owned by
      #     collect (nightly) + asia-close.  Not written by any step in this lane.
      #   intraday — Polygon hourly bars; populated by the collect job, not this lane.
      #   massive_stock_day, stock_personality, oddsmatrix, odds_ohlcv — nightly-only.
      #   gex, flow — served via git Pages (not R2), so no R2 publish needed.
      - name: publish stockdata + feeds to R2 (provisional EOD reaches the data plane)
        if: steps.mutex.outputs.skip != 'true' && steps.guard.outputs.skip != 'true'
        env:
          R2_ENDPOINT: ${{ secrets.R2_ENDPOINT }}
          R2_ACCESS_KEY_ID: ${{ secrets.R2_ACCESS_KEY_ID }}
          R2_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY: ${{ secrets.R2_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY }}
          R2_BUCKET: ${{ secrets.R2_BUCKET }}
        run: |
          python -m scripts.publish_r2 --dirs stockdata --no-manifest \
            || echo "::warning::closingbell R2 stockdata publish failed (non-fatal — data plane lands at nightly)"
          python -m scripts.publish_r2 --dirs feeds --no-manifest \
            || echo "::warning::closingbell R2 feeds publish failed (non-fatal)"

# ── (j) COMMIT — site/ ONLY, with fastpath-style data/ discard guard ─────────────
      # Replicates earlyclose.yml's commit step VERBATIM-IN-SPIRIT (FT-R5/FT-R8):
      #   1. stage site/ FIRST (closingbell_stamp.json is inside site/live/ — included)
      #   2. THEN git checkout -- .  discards unstaged data/ writes (ledger appends, etc.)
      #   3. git clean -fdq data/  removes untracked data/ files
      #   4. rebase-push with --autostash + 5-retry loop with pre-sync collision sweep
      # ORDER IS CRITICAL: stage BEFORE checkout, exactly as intraday-fastpath.yml and
      # earlyclose.yml do.  Reversing the order would cause `git checkout -- .` to
      # revert tracked site/ pages back to HEAD, committing only the stamp — wrong.
      # The nightly daily pipeline remains the sole advancer of every data/ forward ledger.
      - name: commit rendered site + provisional snapshot pointers (ledgers discarded)
        if: steps.mutex.outputs.skip != 'true' && steps.guard.outputs.skip != 'true'
        run: |
          . "${GITHUB_WORKSPACE:-.}/scripts/ci/push_retry.sh"
          git config user.name "dashboard-bot"
          git config user.email "actions@users.noreply.github.com"
          # pre-commit template↔site re-sync (ui.template_site_sync): the shim/externalize
          # step above rewrites the site/ copies of the ~48 templates/-paired plain-copy
          # assets, and only the post-rebase --fix in the push loop heals the divergence —
          # a cancellation/failure between this commit and that heal ships it (engine-render
          # 2026-07-24: run 30057066815 cancelled mid-push-loop landed b6386adb4af, sync gate
          # red on every PR until #3358). Heal BEFORE staging so the first commit is never
          # diverged; the post-rebase --fix stays for the -X theirs mid-render-merge case.
          python -m scripts.check_template_site_sync --fix || true
          # Stage site/ FIRST (order mirrors earlyclose.yml / intraday-fastpath.yml).
          # templates/ too, and ONLY for the plain-copy HTML pairs (index.html, chat.html):
          # optimize_assets re-stamps their templates/ side because the --fix above rewrites
          # their site copy FROM templates/ — a stamp staged site-only is reverted before it
          # reaches main (#3617's fix never reached one returning browser), and staging site/
          # alone would land the pair diverged and red the publish gate. Nothing else in the
          # build path writes templates/. See render.yml.
          # refuse stash/rebase wreckage (2026-08-01 d29e4dd44d: a conflicted
          # autostash apply was staged wholesale — 1,704 pages shipped markers)
          bash "${GITHUB_WORKSPACE:-.}/scripts/ci/strip_conflict_markers.sh"
          git add site/
          # separate + tolerant: `git add site/ templates/` exits 128 when a pathspec
          # matches nothing, and this step runs under `-eo pipefail` — a missing
          # templates/ would abort the commit and lose the whole render rather than
          # just the stamp. Staging site/ keeps its hard-fail semantics.
          git add templates/ 2>/dev/null || true
          git add -f site/live/closingbell_stamp.json 2>/dev/null || true
          git add -f site/stockbrief 2>/dev/null || true
          # Provisional snapshot pointers (same two artifacts earlyclose commits):
          # freshly recomputed regime + market-state latest.json ride to main so later
          # render/engine-render lanes read TODAY's provisional close instead of regressing
          # to the prior one.  Everything else under data/ is discarded.
          # ONE FILE PER LINE: `git add a b` rejects ATOMICALLY when any pathspec is
          # missing — a single masked line would silently drop BOTH pointers.
          git add -f data/regime/latest.json 2>/dev/null || echo "::warning::regime latest.json not staged (missing?) — provisional pointer will not ride"
          git add -f data/market_state/latest.json 2>/dev/null || echo "::warning::market_state latest.json not staged (missing?) — provisional pointer will not ride"
          # THEN discard unstaged data/ writes (FT-R5) — same as earlyclose.yml.
          git checkout -- . 2>/dev/null || true
          git clean -fdq data/ 2>/dev/null || true
          if git diff --cached --quiet; then echo "no rendered-site changes to commit"; exit 0; fi
          SESSION_DATE=$(python3 -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'.'); from lib.nyse_calendar import session_date; print(session_date().isoformat())")
          MSG="closingbell: full close render ${SESSION_DATE} (scope=close)"$'\n\n'"provisional close render (full market scope); nightly is canonical"$'\n'"CLOSINGBELL=1 lane - site/ + regime/market-state snapshot pointers (fastpath idiom); ledgers discarded per FT-R5"$'\n\n'"Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>"
          # Fail-closed conflict gate (P0 2026-08-01, d29e4dd44d / #4167): refuse to
          # commit staged conflict markers or unmerged index entries.
          push_staged_heal site/ templates/ data/ || exit 1
          git commit -m "$MSG"
